release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.27 (Build 28) - Enhanced Update System & Improvements:
- Enhanced automatic update check on app startup with full UpdateDialog support
- Added update check icon in chat list screen (beside theme icon)
- Improved update system with in-app download and automatic installation
- Download progress tracking with real-time percentage and status messages
- Automatic installation dialog opens after download completes
- Retry mechanism for failed downloads with exponential backoff
- Force update support - can enforce required updates
- Works seamlessly on Android 13+ and all previous versions
- Method channel implementation for reliable APK installation
- FileProvider support for secure file sharing on Android 7+
- Responsive update dialogs for all screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- Consistent update experience across all update scenarios
- Better error handling and user feedback
- Contact permission fixes for all Android versions
- Various stability improvements and bug fixes
